symptom: Faint labels after 20-30 pages. Print darkness fades across the roll.
steps: Confirm the printer reports firmware 2.4 and the fuser access door is open.
With the printer idle for at least 10 minutes, run the service-menu fuser pressure reset sequence.
Print a 50-label verification run and keep the first and last labels.
Record the firmware, page count, and ambient temperature in the case notes.

symptom: Cutter jams after 200 sheets and returns after the path is cleared.
steps: Power down and remove the cutter path debris with the approved tool.
Inspect the cutter home sensor and reseat its connector.
Run a 250-sheet test and stop at the first repeat jam.
Record sheet count and sensor state before escalating.

symptom: Media roller slips on the second pass as the roller warms up.
steps: Clean the roller with the approved lint-free method.
Run a 100-label test on the current media lot.
Record the media lot and roller temperature.

symptom: Media roller slips on the second pass as the roller warms up.
steps: Clean the roller with the approved lint-free method.
Check the roller tension screw is at the marked position for firmware 2.4 or 2.5.
Run a 100-label test on the current media lot.
Record the media lot, firmware, and roller temperature.
